ACRAM UC1 console

On UC1:
  bash /home/wrcve/TELEMETRY/dist/ACRAM-UC1.sh

From the Windows project folder:
  .\dist\ACRAM-UC1.cmd

The Windows launcher connects using SSH and asks for your UC1 password.
It contains no saved password. VPN/network access to UC1 must be available.

The default run submits labelled demonstration inputs to the real UC1 ADI:
  Initial risks -> 9 component transactions and 1 aggregate transaction
  SBOM received -> updated component and aggregate risk transactions
  UAM received  -> updated component and aggregate risk transactions

It uses 3 users and 9 configured UC1 devices, verifies ADI storage, shows
console output live, saves logs/results in a unique console-run directory,
and keeps listening for ADI updates after the sequence. Allow MATLAB a little
time to start. Stop it with Ctrl+C or by creating the stop file printed at startup.

Optional arguments for either launcher:
  --check    Check local prerequisites on UC1 without sending transactions.
  --offline  Run the calculations without ADI transactions.
  --help     Print usage.

Requires the MATLAB R2025a installation already present on UC1.
